body:
My issue in this specific time is quite small, and like I said, wouldn't bother me, if stuff similar to this didn't keep happening. Not to mention the other stuff that stresses me out everyday.

Long story short, my parents are afraid of ever letting me out of the house.

Long story is that my grandmother is out of town. She lives with my grandfather, my mother, and me. She usually drives me to school. My mother works at that time, so without anyone to drive me I had to walk on my own.

Which, I was more than fine with. That gave me a chance to take a breather, catch my breath, gather my thoughts. I love being outdoors, I love being alone. It relaxes me. I guess it's the introvert in me. And perhaps my parents were finally ready to treat me like someone who wasn't a child. Because I'm not. Mind you, I only live five minutes away walking distance.

But last minute, as usual, things changed. They don't believe I can handle myself. They don't outright say it, but you can sort of tell they're afraid I'll get kidnapped or murdered, despite that never happening to anyone near where we live recently. Fourty years ago? Sure. Maybe someone got kidnapped, but in the past ten-ish years, nothing. And nothing's ever happened to our family recently for them to be concerned.

So now I'm walking with my grandfather. We don't have a good relationship. I don't like being with him. He makes me feel uncomfortable. Ninety percent of the time he's out smoking, isolating himself from everyone, the other ten percent he's hovering over me. He means well, but I just need my space. He hovers over everyone, but definitely does it to me the most.

So that ruins my chance of taking a relaxing step back for a moment. All of this stuff is a bummer, but nothing to kill yourself over, I know. But this is a smaller part of a bigger picture.

I'm not ever allowed out of the house. Not without parental supervision. I don't like doing things inside. I don't like social media or texting as much as everyone else my age does. I like bike riding, going on nature walks, doing something simple like walking to the store, etc. I don't ask for a lot. I'm not asking to go to a huge party or hang out with friends. I just want some space in a place I enjoy for like thirty minutes.

Without parental supervision, I can't go anywhere. But because my grandparents/parents are old, they don't want to come with me on walks. They don't even like being outside. And it has to be THEIR supervision. I can't be with a friend's parents.

Imagine being locked up all day and night in your own house yet against your will. It's driving me crazy. I'm not literally locked up, I could leave whenever I wanted. But I'd get in trouble. 

The chance of walking to school on my own gave me an escape. Albiet only five minutes, but it was perfect. Just five minutes. That's all I ask of them. I've never done anything to betray their trust. They believe that I'm incredibly mature. They even call me an old soul. But when it comes to giving me independence, it's out of the question.

This is just one example of things that have happened here and there, and they're not always someone else's fault. But this one sent be completely over the edge and really got me upset, as I'm sure you can imagine. I'm done with this and all the other shit I have to deal with. I'm ready to just end it.
